attchmntText: Somi Conveyor Beltings Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Somi Conveyor Beltings Limited approved its standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 14, 2026. Revenue from operations for the half year was Rs. 2972.32 lakhs. Profit before tax stood at Rs. 168.21 lakhs. Net profit for the period was Rs. 123.92 lakhs. Earnings per share were Rs. 1.05. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, were Rs. 11,221.14 lakhs. Net worth was Rs. 8,275.72 lakhs. The debt equity ratio was 0.22. The limited review report was issued by Singhvi and Mehta, Chartered Accountants.
